_: What the live screen may show, and the words that call each up. A concept's words score when heard (weight 1 is one clear mention; under 1 needs saying again, over 1 is unmistakable); its films are shown in turn, least recently shown first. Only films that run by themselves are here: murmuration-motif, your-place-in-the-wave, the-state-stack, house-on-the-sundial, open-seed and tech-evolution wait for a slider, a scroll or a click, so the three that carry an idea stand in as stills (a name ending .jpg is a still, drifted slowly). The idea line is what the Mac's chooser reads to catch the same thing said in other words. A concept's motifs (motifs/<name>.js, small live drawings lifted from the films) draw it in the image cloud, the first not already showing; a concept with no films is the cloud's alone. The motifs below say what each shows: the Mac's Haiku composes pictures from them by these lines.

concepts.idea: The beach and pscale blocks: one block whose nesting is the data (physics), blocks in company (chemistry), minds continuing through blocks in time (biology).
Memory that outlives the model: the shell outlives the crab; an agent's continuity lives in its blocks, not in any one model.
How an LLM reads and writes: tokens, completion, attention at different scales, like the hands of clocks.
Meaning is not in the words: the reader brings it, and the beach is a mirror for whoever reads it.
Reflexivity and co-construction: the observer is inside what is observed; people and their world make each other, round a psychosocial torus.
Emergence: each layer gives rise to the next, tori nested within tori.
Murmuration: many moving as one with no leader, a flock, coordination that is fluid; a room of people as a flock of birds.
Stigmergy: coordinating through traces left in a shared medium, the way ants do; coloured seals on the beach.
The C to B to A transformation: from the current system C, through the fulcrum B, toward the hidden attractor A; a room or an organisation turning.
The hidden attractor: the basin a system keeps falling back into.
Organisation in practice: the Now Catalyst, practices that change how a group works, endosystemics.
Churn: every model replaced within months, everything downstream re-plumbed at each upgrade.
Two directions for AI: the mainstream river of a few big labs, or rain falling everywhere on everyone; every lab building the same crab.
The AI wave: a swell that is coming, what to do before it breaks, riding the barrel.
Open source and the open web: the internet given away, Tim Berners-Lee, code anyone can build on.
Now: today, this morning, the present moment as a smoke ring of attention.
Time and the temporal spindle: the clock as an address, two ways through now, the future planned backward and lived forward.
Genius or scum bucket: all our lives we sort what we hear, this into the scum bucket as rubbish, that into the genius bucket; carrying both through a working life
The systemic kernel: write your own kernel alone, then merge it with others' (the mind meld), and see where they come into register
Threads: work crossing minds and people, one knot at a time, each place handed on

motifs.torus: a ring that turns through itself: the smoke ring of now; reflexivity, the observer inside what is observed
motifs.nested: scales within scales, each layer giving rise to the next: pscale, depth is scale, emergence
motifs.spindle: a ladder of rungs from the year down to this moment, walked one rung deeper: an address, the temporal spindle
motifs.sundial: time as concentric rings, year, month, day, hour, with a hand at now: the clock as an address
motifs.murmuration: many moving as one with no leader: a flock, the fluid end (A), a room coordinating
motifs.buckets: a figure with a yoke carrying a scum bucket and a genius bucket: sorting what we hear into rubbish or genius
motifs.bricks: bricks held solid, loosening, then flying free: C (solid foundations) turning through B to A
motifs.kernels: two kernels written blind sliding into register, lighting where they meet: merging minds, shared ground
motifs.shell: a spiral shell a crab leaves and another enters: the shell outlives the crab, memory that outlives the model
motifs.mirror: a reflecting surface, a figure and its reflection: meaning is not in the words, the reader brings it
motifs.quipu: a hanging cord with pendant threads, knots tied one by one: work crossing minds, a record kept by many hands
motifs.clocks: rings that close as a completion finishes: how an LLM reads and writes, tokens, attention
motifs.wave: a swell rising and curling to break: the AI wave, what to do before it breaks
motifs.basin: a landscape a system keeps rolling back into: the hidden attractor
motifs.rain: many small drops falling everywhere, not one river: many small makers, open and shared, not a few big labs
